observations: Photo 0 shows multiple retail boxes for a DJACK AK-1003 Home Theatre System.
The boxes are stacked in a commercial setting and appear to be shrink-wrapped.
The brand 'DJACK' and model 'AK-1003' are clearly legible on the packaging.
The box art displays a central subwoofer unit and two satellite speakers.
Text on the box claims '3.1 X-BASS', 'Bluetooth Speaker', and 'Hi-Fi multimedia speaker system'.
No actual hardware is visible outside of the boxes.

The box in photo 0 explicitly states '3.1 X-BASS'.
The box in photo 0 features a 'Bluetooth Speaker' logo and text.

risks.proof: A video of the system powered on, paired via Bluetooth, and playing audio.
